steps.title: Add File

audioNote.markdown: After adding your file, be sure to assign it to the appropriate portal so your contacts can view it. To do this, click Portals at the top of the page to return to the portal home.  Select the ellipses to the right of the portal the task should be assigned to.

steps.title: Edit Tasks

audioNote.markdown: Under the "Assign items" tab,  Navigate to the Files widget, select the button Add to open a pop-up module. This will show any files you have created to select and assign to your portal.
